article.title: Spangle將商品資料工具獨立開放予企業品牌
article.summary: Spangle宣布Product Intelligence 360可獨立接入，讓企業品牌把商品資料用於自有電商及AI工具。
highlights: 商品記錄可結合商品屬性、銷售情況及顧客查詢，由品牌審批上線。
article.why: 商品管理團隊可先把規格和顧客選購用語對齊，再決定哪些內容適合對外發放。
article.next_step: 挑一個品類，抽查商品屬性、常見問題和人工批准紀錄，再測試匯出。
article.detail: Spangle表示，Product Intelligence 360以個別商品為單位，整理規格、成交情況及顧客查詢等資料。公司公布企業品牌可以透過API或商品資料獨立接入，品牌團隊仍負責審批上線內容。測試時可先集中在單一品類，確認資料可追溯到原有來源，也可按需要回復。
article.title_en: Spangle makes its product intelligence tool available separately to enterprise brands
article.summary_en: Spangle announced standalone access to Product Intelligence 360 for enterprise brands to use product data in commerce and AI tools.
highlights_en: Teams can connect through APIs or product feeds.
Product records can combine attributes, sales and shopper queries, subject to brand approval before publishing.
article.why_en: Merchandising teams can align specs with shopper language before releasing product information.
article.next_step_en: Pick one category and check attributes, common questions and the human approval record before export.
article.detail_en: Spangle says Product Intelligence 360 organizes specifications, sales and shopper questions at product level. Enterprise brands can connect it independently through APIs or product feeds, while brand teams approve public changes. Start with one category and check that each item can be traced back to its original source and reverted when needed.
